new_result.name: QFORM-DESTRUCTIVE-GRAM-DEFECT-STABILITY-v1
new_result.statement: For physical cross matrices M0,D let N=[M0^T M0-(M0+D)^T(M0+D)]_+ with eigenvalues nu_j. Then for k+rho<=d, s_k(M0+D)^2 >= (s_{k+rho}(M0)^2-nu_{rho+1})_+. A further operator-norm tail eta costs only eta by singular-value Weyl.
new_result.scope: deterministic original-coordinate matrix stability; no probabilistic rotation or convolution
new_result.continuity: not intrinsic to compiler; continuous density follows in the D5 receiver branch

spectral_split_corollary: For E=sum theta_a v_a v_a^T, take D_h=E_{|theta|>h}[I,J]. High modes have arbitrary signs/magnitudes and are charged only through their destructive Gram-defect profile; all modes |theta|<=h cost only h, plus any dense tail norm delta.

partner_result_applied.name: QFORM-ADAPTIVE-RESERVE-ENVELOPE-v1
partner_result_applied.application: For M=M0+D+L+R+T, rank L<=ell, applied s_q(M)>=max_p[s_{q+ell+p}(M0+D)-s_{p+1}(R)]-delta to the new Gram-defect lower profile.

actual_example.large_packet: D=tJ0, J0^T=-J0 and J0^T J0=I; symmetric dilation has 20 eigenvalues +|t| and 20 eigenvalues -|t| for arbitrary t
actual_example.other_packets: rank-one arbitrary L; arbitrary R with s_6(R)<=1/5; full symmetric T with ||T||op<=1/10
actual_example.exact_target_check: three untouched eigenvalue-2 spectators before T imply s_3(A)>=19/10 after T

unresolved_implication: From only s_3(A)>=1, force a product-preserving physical certificate with sufficient D5 reserve and controlled destructive Gram defect, or route failure to a completed non-D5 branch. Exact rank-three matrices show D5 alone cannot be universal.
next_step: Seek a structural dichotomy in terms of destructive Gram deficit versus localized/aggregate rank-three exits, rather than another norm-only stability compiler.
